name: Long Recall Variant 1
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 50-page annual report contains: total revenue $12.5M (page 3), operating costs $8.2M (page 7), employee count 450 (page 12), R&D spending $2.1M (page 18), international revenue $3.8M (page 22), net profit $1.9M (page 28), dividend $0.45/share (page 33), stock price $24.50 (page 40).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
